originalTitle: Snap is launching a new Specs AI tool, and it’s coming to iOS and Mac

content: Snap is introducing “Specs Intelligence,” a new AI assistant that can connect other digital accounts to help you with things like work tasks and keeping track of travel information. It seems similar to AI assistants like Meta’s Muse and Gemini’s Spark, though Snap is pitching Specs Intelligence as an “anticipatory AI service” that “helps you manage what needs attention today, so you can make progress toward your longer-term goals.” Like with other AI assistants, you can also chat with it. Specs Intelligence is being launched alongside Specs, Snap’s first consumer pair of augmented reality glasses. But it’s also available on iOS today in preview, and you can get on a waitlist for the “full early-access experience” that’s coming to Mac. Snap wouldn’t say on the record how the preview differs from the full experience. Here’s how Specs Intelligence works, according to Snap: > SPECS Intelligence builds an understanding of your goals, priorities, relationships, and routines from the apps and tools you choose to connect. The service is designed to carry that personal context across devices and deepens its understanding over time, helping you move between work, personal responsibilities, and the things you care about. > SPECS Intelligence is designed to anticipate when help would be useful and surface relevant information and actions without waiting for a prompt. Before a meeting, it could highlight decisions to make, questions to ask, and things to remember. For an upcoming trip, it could bring together flight, hotel, and dinner plans while flagging a work deadline that falls during the visit. If you’re using Specs Intelligence on the Specs AR glasses, Specs can pull personal content and place it “directly into view” when relevant, like when you ask for a daily briefing before work. According to a video, Specs Intelligence can connect to apps like Gmail and Slack. Specs Intelligence uses “a proprietary combination of open-source models hosted in the US alongside local LLMs,” according to spokesperson Cassie Bumgarner, who adds that “We regularly update the mixture of models as we continue iterating towards the best version of SPECS Intelligence.” But the company faces real challenges in that it needs users to trust it with their information and with data from connected services. Snap is trying to get ahead of those concerns by saying that it can’t view or access personal content you use with Specs Intelligence and that “Personal content from connected accounts will not be used to train or fine-tune Snap’s AI models, or to serve personalized ads.” But it’s still a tall order, especially given how we’ve found other AI assistants with broad access to data to be pretty unnerving. [Video: Snap Specs Intelligence Demo]
chineseTitle: Snap 推出新的 Specs AI 工具，并将登陆 iOS 和 Mac

chineseContent: Snap 推出了“Specs Intelligence”，这是一种新的人工智能助手，可以连接其他数字帐户，帮助您完成工作任务和跟踪旅行信息等事情。它看起来与 Meta 的 Muse 和 Gemini 的 Spark 等人工智能助手类似，尽管 Snap 将 Specs Intelligence 定位为“预期人工智能服务”，“帮助你管理今天需要关注的事情，这样你就可以在实现长期目标方面取得进展”。与其他人工智能助手一样，你也可以与它聊天。 Specs Intelligence 与 Snap 首款消费者增强现实眼镜 Specs 一起推出。但今天它也可以在 iOS 上预览，并且您可以进入候补名单，以获得即将登陆 Mac 的“完整抢先体验”。 Snap 没有在记录中透露预览版与完整体验有何不同。根据 Snap 的说法，Specs Intelligence 的工作原理如下： > SPECS Intelligence 通过您选择连接的应用程序和工具来了解您的目标、优先事项、关系和例程。该服务旨在跨设备传递个人背景，并随着时间的推移加深其理解，帮助您在工作、个人责任和您关心的事情之间切换。 > SPECS Intelligence 旨在预测帮助何时有用并显示相关信息和操作，而无需等待提示。在会议之前，它可以突出显示要做出的决定、要提出的问题以及要记住的事情。对于即将到来的旅行，它可以整合航班、酒店和晚餐计划，同时标记访问期间的工作截止日期。如果您在 Specs AR 眼镜上使用 Specs Intelligence，Specs 可以提取个人内容并在相关时将其“直接置于视图中”，例如当您之前要求每日简报时
whyItMatters: 这条信息属于 AI 与科技趋势信号，适合用于观察工具选型、产品机会、开发者关注点和技术路线变化。
